capabilities: Preview embedded .eml files directly in reading mode
Set the preview frame's width and height with image-style size syntax
disambiguation: Not an email client; it only previews .eml files that are embedded in notes.
extras: The README describes two alternative plugins (Emails, Obsidian Code Previews) and their tradeoffs, such as searchable but potentially polluting inline email content, and notes a rendering issue with non-ASCII characters in one alternative.
motivation: The author sometimes inserts downloaded .eml emails into notes and found it inconvenient that reading mode only offered a button opening an external email app.
problem: Obsidian shows embedded .eml attachments only as buttons that open an external email client, so the email content cannot be viewed directly in the note.

relations.evidence: The following plugins can be used for very similar purposes.
The following plugins can be used for very similar purposes.

summary: Preview plugin that renders embedded .eml email files inside notes in reading mode, the way images are previewed.
